recordType: research-only synthetic case; not production implementation

tools.name: calculate_bazi_chart
tools.title: Calculate Bazi Chart
tools.description: Calculate a deterministic OpenFate Bazi/Four Pillars chart with True Solar Time correction, Day Master, DAYUN_SECOND_V2 onset receipts, Da Yun cycles, and branch interactions. Pass an exact birth time plus timezone or timezoneId for a calculated V2 onset; otherwise inspect the explicit unavailable/fallback receipt.

year.description: Birth year. Use the lunar year when calendarType is lunar.

hour.description: Birth hour in local civil time, 0-23. Omit when birth time is unknown.

minute.description: Birth minute in local civil time.

second.description: Birth second in local civil time.

gender.description: Birth gender used for Da Yun direction.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in decimal degrees. Enables true solar time correction.

timezone.description: UTC offset in hours for the birth clock time, such as 8 for China or -5 for US Eastern Standard Time.

timezoneId.description: Optional IANA timezone ID, such as Asia/Shanghai or America/New_York.

dstOffset.description: Daylight saving offset in hours to remove from civil clock time. Use 1 for one-hour DST.

isLeapMonth.description: Whether the lunar input month is a leap month. Used only when calendarType is lunar.

enableTrueSolarTime.description: Apply true solar time when longitude and timezone data are available.

dayBoundaryMode.description: Day-change rule. ZI_HOUR_23 means 23:00 starts the next day pillar.

tools.name: detect_bazi_interactions
tools.title: Detect Bazi Interactions
tools.description: Detect raw Earthly Branch relationship occurrences for a natal chart and optional annual and Da Yun branches. Preserves every matching pillar position, including repeated branches. Covers clashes, six-combinations, the eight central-branch half-trines (COMBINATION_HALF), full trines, directionals, punishments, destructions, and harms. Results establish relationship presence, not weights, cancellation, or automatic transformation; targetElement is an affinity, not transformed energy.

hourBranch.description: Natal hour branch. Omit when birth time is unknown.

annualBranch.description: Optional annual or target branch. Preserved as the annual pillar role, independently of repeated natal branches.

dayunBranch.description: Optional Da Yun branch. Preserved as the dayun pillar role, independently of the annual and natal branches.

tools.name: calculate_true_solar_time
tools.title: Calculate True Solar Time
tools.description: Calculate OpenFate True Solar Time from civil birth time, longitude, timezone, and optional DST offset. Use this when explaining why the hour pillar may differ from ordinary clock-time tools.

timezone.description: UTC offset in hours for the clock time.

timezoneId.description: IANA timezone ID, such as Asia/Shanghai.

tools.name: reverse_bazi_to_solar_times
tools.title: Reverse Bazi To Solar Times
tools.description: Find possible Gregorian datetimes that produce a given four-pillar Bazi string. This is useful when a user only has a Bazi chart or screenshot. This lookup uses clock-time pillars without location-based true solar correction.

bazi.description: Four pillars separated by spaces, for example: 戊寅 己未 己卯 辛未.

endYear.description: End year for brute-force lookup. Defaults to the current year.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching datetimes to return.

tools.name: get_openfate_bazi_policy
tools.title: Get OpenFate Bazi Policy
tools.description: Return OpenFate calculation policy and LLM guidance for Bazi chart calls.

tools.name: get_openfate_bazi_resources
tools.title: Get OpenFate Bazi Resources
tools.description: Return canonical OpenFate URLs for charting, readings, compatibility, wealth, true solar time, and AI crawler metadata.

policy.daYunTimingGuidance: Present an exact onset only when chart.daYun.timing.status is CALCULATED and version is DAYUN_SECOND_V2. UNAVAILABLE retains legacy scalar fields only as an explicitly labeled fallback.
policy.dayBoundaryMeaning: ZI_HOUR_23 means 23:00-23:59 is calculated with the next day pillar.
policy.locationGuidance: For professional accuracy, pass longitude plus timezone or timezoneId. Do not rely on city-name guessing.
policy.dstGuidance: If birth certificate time includes daylight saving time, pass dstOffset so the physical solar time is corrected.
policy.reverseLookupGuidance: Use reverse_bazi_to_solar_times only as a candidate finder, then recalculate with location data.
policy.interactionGuidance: Branch interactions are raw relationship occurrences identified by pillar roles. Preserve duplicate branch positions and distinct annual/dayun roles. COMBINATION_HALF requires a central branch (子午卯酉); a full trine does not erase its half-trine occurrences. targetElement is a relationship affinity; legacy resultElement on TRINE/DIRECTIONAL has the same affinity-only meaning. NOT_EVALUATED means transformation was not assessed, not that it formed or failed. Do not treat occurrences as additive weights or automatically cancel clashes.

policy.dstGuidance: If birth certificate time includes daylight saving time, pass dstOffset so the physical solar time is corrected.
